_fixture_note: SYNTHETIC fixture, not captured from a live source. Models a genuinely minimal, but well-formed, Tribe Events REST API v1 event record: only the fields this generic collector treats as load-bearing (id, title, start_date, url) are populated; every optional field (venue, cost, cost_details, categories, tags, description, timezone, utc_start_date/utc_end_date, end_date, image) is absent or empty, exactly as a compatible-but-sparser The Events Calendar site might return for a bare-bones listing. Used to prove the generic collector never fabricates a value for a field the source did not supply.
